result.summary: The image depicts a typical residential street with row houses and mature street trees providing shade. A sidewalk is present on the far side, separated from the roadway by a small grass buffer and a line of parallel-parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential environment.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic lights are present, the environment is characterized by long crossing distances and faded pavement markings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings at the intersection are significantly faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is wide with no median or curb extensions, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large trees on the left corner may obstruct sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and vehicles approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
